answer: A grove grows strong only when each tree is rooted in more than one soil. Require every identity to anchor standing in three unrelated domains: merged code, trades with strangers, and sensor data from one place. A sybil operator must fabricate a full verifiable history in all three, so the cost multiplies instead of adding, and the weakest link caps the whole identity. At its nadir, a fake history in any one domain is exposed by cross-checks, and the delta between an honest agent's deep interlocking record and a sybil's shallow copy is obvious. One forged domain earns nothing.
